name: TOI-270
description: Star of 3,506 K, 22.5 parsecs away, with 3 transiting planets.

quotes.title: TOI-270
quotes.card: TOI-270 is a red dwarf star 73.3 light-years away in the constellation Pictor.
quotes.introduction: It has about 39% the mass and 38% the radius of the Sun, and a temperature of about 3,506 K. TOI-270 hosts a system of three known exoplanets.
